description: Level 1 lessons 001-003 are public in every track. Basic unlocks Levels 1-2; Pro unlocks Levels 1-4; Gold unlocks Levels 1-5. Existing subscribers must be checked for entitlement compatibility before deployment.

freePreview.note: Level 1 lessons 001-003 are always accessible to any unauthenticated visitor in every curriculum color/track.

_note_testDrive: Test Drive provides access only to lessons whose IDs appear in sampleLessons[]. A sample lesson can come from any level; listing it here does NOT unlock the entire level for Test Drive members.
